description: This file defines the 'Action' class within the 'Opencart\System\Engine' namespace. It is responsible for handling routing and execution of controller actions within the OpenCart framework, including parsing route strings, loading controllers from the registry, and invoking the appropriate method with arguments.

classes.name: Action
classes.description: Represents an action that can be executed, encapsulating route parsing and controller method invocation within the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Action object by parsing the route string, separating the route and method if specified.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the route string associated with the action.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the controller method associated with this action, injecting dependencies from the registry and passing any additional arguments.
